title: Free GCSE and 11+ Revision Resources from UK Online Tuition
description: Free GCSE English, GCSE Maths, Year 11 and 11+ diagnostics and revision guides from UK Online Tuition. No sign-up required.

children: Use these free UK Online Tuition resources to identify gaps quickly, choose what to practise next and make revision more focused. No sign-up is required.
Start with the 15-minute English diagnostic if you are unsure which skills are costing marks.
For AQA students, use the Paper 1 guide to separate the skills needed for Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q5.
The 12-question maths diagnostic samples number, algebra, ratio, percentages, geometry and probability.
Use the 20-point exam-readiness check to assess whether revision habits are active, targeted and exam-focused.
This short diagnostic gives a quick snapshot of vocabulary, grammar, comprehension and verbal reasoning.

Choose one diagnostic, complete it independently, mark it carefully, and turn the weakest two areas into the next week’s practice. Repeating targeted practice is usually more useful than collecting more resources without using them.
